spanish: De faces de canas te levantarás, y honrarás faces de anciano, y temerás desde tu Dios; yo Jehová.

findings.issue: Unmarked supplied clitic te has no token; qal imperfect 2ms is simply you-shall-rise, and the clitic adds a reflexive the stem does not license.
Feminine singular gray-hair noun is rendered with the Spanish plural-form noun canas; the concept is unchanged.

notes: faces (twice), tú futures, honrar, anciano, desde tu Dios, and verbless yo Jehová match the tokens.
